evidence.quote: RNA expression for the in vivo study and one in vitro study was analyzed using the Human Exon ST 1.0 microarray platform (Affymetrix)
RNA from the MRKAd5 vs. YF-17D comparative in vitro study was analyzed using the Agilent SurePrint G3 Human GE 8 × 60K microarray platform (Agilent Technologies)
Quantitative real-time PCR was performed as described in ref. 17.
Serum cytokine analysis was performed using the Lincoplex High Sensitivity kit
